content.text:
Finding submitted: **deviation** at §7.6 (p0032).

- **Issue:** §7.6 makes Customer pay USD 25,000/day as liquidated damages for any dependency delay — uncapped, no materiality threshold or notice requirement. It is the only LD/penalty provision in the document, and it runs against us.
- **Fix (preferred):** Replaced with an express statement that Customer owes no liquidated damages or penalties, giving Vendor schedule/service-level relief plus documented unavoidable costs for our dependency delays instead.
- Redline validated (`ok:true`) before submission.
